answer: Use staked sortition with tenure: voting seats are drawn at random, weighted by locked stake and by how long one identity has behaved honestly. An attacker who splits funds across a thousand clones finds each clone weak and newborn, so its chance to wander into a deciding seat stays tiny; pooling the stake into one identity is stronger but then one misstep costs everything. A public atlas of seat draws lets anyone audit the lottery, and honest agents keep a lotus-like clean record that only grows with time, making patience cheaper than forgery.
